class.name: arm_control/AriaHardwareInterface
class.description: ARIA Hardware Interface: Sim/Hardware switchable system interface for the ARIA 5-DoF arm. In sim mode, acts as passthrough (Gazebo handles physics). In hardware mode, bridges ros2_control to the ESP32 micro-ROS firmware (node 'aria_esp32'): it publishes /aria/servo_commands (degrees) and subscribes /aria/servo_states (degrees), converting to/from radians.
